run_benchmark_train: run a training benchmark for a Detectron2 model using the benchmark script with --task train
run_benchmark_eval: run an evaluation benchmark for a Detectron2 model using the benchmark script with --task eval
run_benchmark_data: run a data loader benchmark to measure dataloader throughput using the benchmark script with --task data
run_benchmark_data_advanced: run an advanced data loader benchmark with detailed bottleneck analysis using --task data_advanced
review_RAM_msg: review the RAM_msg function that reports current virtual memory usage in gigabytes
